title: Galactic Black Hole
body: The black hole at the center of our galaxy has the mass of $$4$$ million solar masses (1 solar mass $$=$$ $$1.989\times10**{30}\,\text{kg}$$). $$Take$$ G=$$6.674\times10**{-11}\,\tfrac{\text{N}\cdot\text{m}**2}{\text{kg}**2}$$ and c=$$3.0\times10**{8}\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$.
